name: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. Common Stock
description: Oruka Therapeutics Inc a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel monoclonal antibody therapeutics for psoriasis (PsO) and other inflammatory and immunology (I&I) indications. Its programs are to treat and potentially modify disease by targeting mechanisms with efficacy and safety involved in disease pathology and the activity of pathogenic tissue-resident memory T cells (TRMs). Its program, ORKA-001, is designed to target the p19 subunit of interleukin-23 (IL-23p19) for the treatment of PsO. Its co-lead program, ORKA-002, is designed to target interleukin-17A and interleukin-17F (IL-17A/F) for the treatment of PsO, hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), psoriatic arthritis (PsA), and other conditions.
